sn36.21:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn36.21:1.2: atha kho moḷiyasīvako paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn36.21:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho moḷiyasīvako paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn36.21:1.4: santi hi bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
sn36.21:1.5: “yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvediyati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ pubbekatahetū”ti.
sn36.21:2.1: pittasamuṭṭhānānipi kho sīvaka idhekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
sn36.21:2.2: sāmampi kho etaṃ sīvaka veditabbaṃ, yathā pittasamuṭṭhānānipi idhekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjantīti,
sn36.21:2.3: lokassapi kho etaṃ sīvaka saccasammataṃ. yathā pittasamuṭṭhānānipi idhekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
sn36.21:2.4: tatra sīvaka ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ vādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
sn36.21:2.5: “yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvediyati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ pubbekatahetū”ti.
sn36.21:2.6: yañca sāmaṃ ñātaṃ tañca atidhāvanti, yañca loke saccasammataṃ tañca atidhāvanti.
sn36.21:3.7: kammavipākajānipi kho sīvaka idhekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
sn36.21:3.9: yathā kammavipākajānipi kho sīvaka idhekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti,
sn36.21:3.12: tanu sīvaka ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
sn36.21:3.13: “yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvediyati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetū”ti.
sn36.21:3.14: yañca sāmaṃ ñātaṃ tañca atidhāvanti, yañca loke saccasammataṃ tañca atidhāvanti.
sn36.21:4.1: evaṃ vutte moḷiyasīvako paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn36.21:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata”nti.
